entries.source: A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.
entries.target: 一个彪悍的、受过严格龙战士训练的兽人士兵。

entries.source: An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.
entries.target: 一只穿着板甲的兽人，魔法似乎在它周围渐渐衰弱。

entries.source: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
entries.target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手持一面盾牌和一把致命的战斧。

entries.source: A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
entries.target: 一只肥胖过度的兽人，他有一头油乎乎的黑色长发，皮肤油腻且布满麻坑。他身穿板甲，手握一把几乎和他一样大的花岗岩双手斧。

entries.source: A not-so-strange growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片不怎么奇怪的植物。

entries.source: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
entries.target: 快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；吾辈就是要去，打小白兔……

entries.source: Instead of fur, this rat has crystals growing on its back, which provide extra protection.
entries.target: 这只耗子背上长的不是毛发而是晶体，它因此获得了额外的保护。

entries.source: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. It seems quite unhappy about you being in its lair.
entries.target: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。它很不高兴你闯入它的地盘。

entries.source: A huge worm coloured as the sand it inhabits. This particular sandworm seems to have been bred for one purpose only: the eradication of everything that is non-sandworm, such as... you.
entries.target: 一只伪装成沙子颜色的巨大沙虫。这只特殊的沙虫生来只有一个目标：消灭所有非沙虫的异类，比如……你。

entries.source: This unholy creature looks like a wingless dragon in shape, but it is sand-colored, making it all the more dangerous for its prey.
entries.target: 这只邪恶的生物外形酷似无翼之龙，但浑身呈沙色，这让它对其猎物更加危险。

entries.source: The ground shakes as this huge worm burrows towards you, its gigantic mouth just as capable of devouring flesh as stone.
entries.target: 这只巨大的沙虫挖地道靠近你时，大地在震颤。它的巨口既能吞噬血肉，也能吞下石头。

entries.source: Space and time seem to bend around this huge worm.
entries.target: 这只沙虫似乎扭曲了周围的时空。

entries.source: This huge worm burrows through the earth using its powerful corrosive saliva.
entries.target: 这只巨大的沙虫使用它腐蚀性的唾液挖掘泥土。

entries.source: Through some terrible process that remains mysterious, this creature's shadow has been torn from its body and given unlife.
entries.target: 通过某种神秘的可怕手段，这只生物的影子被从身体上剥离出来，并被赋予了亡灵般的存在。

entries.source: Shivgoroth are mighty ice elementals, torn away from their home world by a powerful magic.
entries.target: 西弗格罗斯是强大的寒冰元素生物，被一股强大的魔法从它们的故乡世界带离。

entries.source: A haphazard collection of crumbling bones, with jerky movements that remind you of a child playing with a marionette.  It only has one arm, but that's all it needs to hold a sword.
entries.target: 一堆杂乱拼凑、摇摇欲坠的骨骸，动作僵硬抽搐，令你想起孩童手中玩弄的木偶。它只有一条手臂，但握住一把剑也就够了。

entries.source: A frail skeleton; just about the only bones that aren't cracked are its arms.  It's missing a hand, but a notch has been carved into its wrist to let it pull back a bowstring regardless.
entries.target: 一具脆弱的骨架；几乎只有双臂的骨头没有开裂。它缺少了一只手，不过手腕上刻了一道凹槽，刚好可以卡住弓弦拉弓上箭。

entries.source: Given its condition, you're less inclined to think this skeleton knows proper spells, rather than simply disgorging its magical energy as it breaks down.  This doesn't make it much less dangerous to be around, mind you.
entries.target: 看着它残破的样子，你与其相信这只骷髅会释放魔法，不如相信它只是在身躯逐渐破碎时胡乱喷射奥术能量。不过，这一点也没有降低它的危险性，小心。

entries.source: The forces binding this skeleton together are resilient enough to let it hold a shield and swing a weapon as well as it could have in life.  It's still wearing its old armor, in rusty but servicable condition.
entries.target: 维系这只骷髅身躯的力量足够坚韧，让它像生前一样持盾挥击。它仍穿着原来的旧盔甲，虽已锈迹斑斑，却还堪使用。

entries.source: Nobody scavenged the high-quality bow from this archer before it was raised from the dead.  You're about to wish the world had more grave-robbers.
entries.target: 在被复活之前，这位弓箭手的遗体上居然还保留着一张还不错的弓。你开始觉得，世界上如果有更多的盗墓贼就好了。

entries.source: This skeleton has been imbued with far more magical energy than normal, and serves as a conduit of its master's spellcasting prowess.
entries.target: 这只骷髅的身上充盈着远超常规的魔法力量，充当其主人施法威能的导管。

entries.source: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
entries.target: 它感觉不到疼痛。它的动作流畅而有力，足以撕裂天然的肌肉。它一定来自一具新鲜的尸体，因为它的骨头、装甲和武器都完好如新。而且，它怒不可遏。

entries.source: This skeleton can fire arrows and nock new ones with blinding speed.  Arcane forces pull its bones with unnatural precision - its arms will never tremble or get tired.
entries.target: 这只骷髅可以飞速地拈弓射箭，奥术的力量使它的身躯达到了常人无法企及的精确度——它的手臂永远不会颤抖，也永远不会疲累。

entries.source: Most skeletons announce their presence with a chorus of rattling bones; this one's been charred black and has enough cartilage between its joints to muffle its approach.  The first you'll see of it will be the flash of its blade.
entries.target: 普通骷髅骨节之间的吱嘎猛响会早早暴露它们的行踪，但这只骷髅的身躯被烧得焦黑，关节间的软骨缓冲着骨节的转动。当你看到它时，它银光闪耀的刀刃已经出现在你的眼前。

entries.source: This large snake hisses at you, angry at being disturbed.
entries.target: 这条大蛇向你发出嘶嘶声，对被打扰感到愤怒。

entries.source: It has a copper head and sharp venomous fangs.
entries.target: 它长着铜色的脑袋和锋利的毒牙。

entries.source: As you approach, the snake coils up and rattles its tail threateningly.
entries.target: 你一靠近，这只蛇便盘旋竖起并用尾巴发出警告的声音。

entries.source: It is a large snake with a hooded face.
entries.target: 这是一条面部呈兜帽状的大蛇。

entries.source: It has glistening black skin, a sleek body, and highly venomous fangs.
entries.target: 它有着油亮光滑的黑色皮肤、流线型的身体和剧毒的毒牙。

entries.source: You recoil in fear as you notice this gigantic snake.  It seeks to crush the life out of you.
entries.target: 看到这条巨蛇，你恐惧地向后退缩。它想把你活活绞死。
